description: Plan limiting failed logins: after 5 failed attempts from one IP address within 15 minutes, `POST /login` answers 429 until the window has passed. Project files: `src/routes/login.ts` (the login handler; it answers 401 on a wrong password), `src/routes/signup.ts` (the signup handler), `src/lib/http.ts` (shared route middleware: `withJson()`, `withCors(origins)` and `withLimit(name, limit, windowSeconds, options?)`, which counts requests per client IP in Redis and answers 429 once the count is over the limit; `options.countIf(response)` decides which responses are counted, and `signup.ts` uses `withLimit("signup", 3, 3600)`), `src/lib/redis.ts` (the shared Redis client), `src/lib/__tests__/http.test.ts` and `src/routes/__tests__/login.test.ts`. Available commands (from package.json scripts): `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`.

expected_outcome.description: The plan limits logins with the existing `withLimit` middleware from `src/lib/http.ts`, counting only failed attempts (for example through its `countIf` option), instead of building a second failure counter or rate limiter of its own.
